Then $M(N)/N$ tends to the continuous Erdős minimum-overlap constant $C_{1b}$ as $N \to \infty$.

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $A, B \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$ be disjoint finite sets with $A \cup B = \{1, \dots, 2n\}$ and $|A| = |B|$. Then the minimum overlap $M(n)$ is at most the maximum overlap of $A$ and $B$, the supremum over $k \in \mathbb{Z}$ of $\#\{(a, b) \in A \times B : a - b = k\}$.

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, $M(n)$ is the least value of the maximum overlap of $A$ and $B$, the supremum over $k \in \mathbb{Z}$ of $\#\{(a, b) \in A \times B : a - b = k\}$, taken over all pairs of disjoint finite sets $A, B \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$ with $A \cup B = \{1, \dots, 2n\}$ and $|A| = |B|$.

nodes.summary: For finite sets $A, B \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$ there is an integer $k$ such that the maximum overlap of $A$ and $B$, the supremum over $j \in \mathbb{Z}$ of $\#\{(a, b) \in A \times B : a - b = j\}$, equals $\#\{(a, b) \in A \times B : a - b = k\}$.

nodes.summary: For finite sets $A, B \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$, the maximum overlap of $A$ and $B$ is the natural number obtained as the supremum over all integers $k$ of $\#\{(a, b) \in A \times B : a - b = k\}$.
nodes.title: Maximum overlap

nodes.summary: For a natural number $N$, the normalized minimum overlap is the real number $M(N) / N$, where $M(N)$ is the Erdős minimum overlap function; for $N = 0$ the quotient is $0$ by the convention $x / 0 = 0$.
nodes.title: Normalized minimum overlap

nodes.summary: For finite sets $A, B \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$ and every integer $k$, the overlap $\#\{(a, b) \in A \times B : a - b = k\}$ is at most the maximum overlap of $A$ and $B$.
nodes.title: Overlaps are bounded by the maximum overlap

nodes.summary: For finite sets $A, B \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$ and an integer $k$, the overlap of $A$ and $B$ at $k$ is the number of pairs $(a, b) \in A \times B$ with $a - b = k$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
